paragraphs: The peaked cap is worn less and less on patrol and remains the emblem of the job anyway. It appears on badges, on doors and in every photograph taken at a ceremony, which means the object matters far more as a symbol than as headwear.

The model is light at 18,300 polygons and 19,052 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 9 maps, 4 at 4096x4096 and 5 at 2048x2048. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits law enforcement visualisation, character accessories, film and television costume, game assets, editorial illustration and museum material. On sale since 2016.

A match ball is a licensed product with a season attached, which is why a packed one is a different object from a used one. It is retail rather than sport: the box, the seal and the untouched surface are the whole proposition.
The model holds 33,232 polygons and 16,898 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, supplied packed. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits sports retail and e-commerce visualisation, packaging and product imagery, advertising, collectible presentation and editorial illustration. On sale since 2026.

Haussmann rebuilt Paris to a rulebook: the same height, the same stone, the same ironwork balcony on the same floor across the whole city. That is why one building reads as Paris rather than as a building, and why a single facade can stand in for a street.
The model is dense at 786,342 polygons and 827,159 vertices, built in quads only with overlapping UVs. It carries StemCell certification.
At $49 it suits architectural and urban visualisation, film and television backgrounds, tourism imagery, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

Home fitness is sold as a scene rather than as equipment. The mat, the weights, the speaker and the towel together say something a single dumbbell cannot, which is why this arrangement appears in almost every advertisement for the category.
The set holds 279,025 polygons and 286,588 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits fitness and lifestyle visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, advertising, interior scenes, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

The 1911 has been in continuous production for over a century, and the reason is the grip angle. It points naturally for most hands, which is a subjective quality that no amount of later engineering has been able to argue away.

The model is light at 23,729 polygons and 24,556 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 19 maps, 15 at 4096x4096 and 4 at 2048x2048. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits game weapons, film and television props, historical and documentary visualisation, simulation and editorial illustration. On sale since 2017.

A portable cabin is a building that arrives on a lorry and leaves the same way. Everything about it is compromised for that: the size is a road width, the structure has to survive being lifted by its corners, and nothing inside can be fragile.
The model holds 44,976 polygons and 47,141 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 4 maps all at 4096x4096. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits site and facilities visualisation, security and construction presentation, industrial and urban scenes, film backgrounds and game environments. On sale since 2026.

A rack mounted workstation is an unusual product: professional computing hardware built for a room where nobody sits. It is bought by studios and render farms that need the same machine as the desktop, only twenty of them and out of earshot.
The model holds 104,234 polygons and 54,857 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits data centre and studio visualisation, hardware marketing, technical documentation, server room scenes, film sets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

A survey AUV is a torpedo that maps things. It is launched, follows a programmed lawnmower pattern for hours with no communication at all, and surfaces where it was told to, having recorded a piece of seabed nobody has seen.
The model is light at 23,331 polygons and 24,261 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and carries StemCell certification. A second build is offered separately.

At $49 it suits marine research and offshore visualisation, technology and defence presentation, documentary graphics, education material, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

The motorised unicycle is a recurring dead end in transport history. Somebody rebuilds one every few decades, it photographs brilliantly, and it turns out that a vehicle which cannot be steered by leaning has no advantage over anything with two wheels.
The model holds 78,843 polygons and 84,611 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in red and in used condition. It carries StemCell certification.
At $49 it suits period and design visualisation, museum and exhibition work, film and television props, advertising, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

Without the antenna, the direction finder is a box with a screen, and that is how it is actually seen by the crew using it. The bearing appears as a line, the operator turns towards it, and the search area collapses from a region to a corridor.

The model is light at 25,179 polygons and 26,232 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 7 maps all at 4096x4096, supplied as the unit alone. It carries StemCell certification.
At $49 it suits search and rescue visualisation, avionics and marine equipment marketing, cockpit and control scenes, training material and editorial illustration. On sale since 2021.

A pool robot has to climb walls, which is the part people underestimate. Buoyancy, tracks and a pump that pushes it against the surface all work together, and the machine spends half its cycle upside down relative to where it started.
The model holds 173,917 polygons and 96,080 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits pool and outdoor living visualisation, appliance and equipment marketing, e-commerce imagery, property scenes, film props and game environments. On sale since 2022.

The domestic manipulator is the hardest unsolved problem in consumer robotics. Vacuuming was easy because a mistake costs nothing; picking up a wine glass is a different category entirely, and every concept in this space is a bet on when that changes.

The model holds 67,344 polygons and 35,978 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and rigged builds are offered separately, including native rigs for Maya, Cinema 4D and Modo.
At $49 it suits robotics and technology visualisation, home and interior scenes, advertising, concept presentation, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

Plasma televisions were better than the screens that replaced them in almost every way that mattered for picture quality, and they lost anyway on weight, heat and power. As an object it dates a room precisely to a few years either side of its release.
The model carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits interior and period visualisation, electronics and screen mockups, film and television sets, game environments, advertising and editorial illustration. On sale since 2016.

Satellite navigation needs a constellation rather than a satellite, because a position is the intersection of several distances. Every spacecraft in one is therefore identical, replaceable and mostly interesting for how reliably it can be built again.
The model holds 161,742 polygons and 168,779 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits space and technology visualisation, news and documentary graphics, education and museum work, navigation presentation and editorial illustration. On sale since 2023.
